name: code-oracle-mcp
description: Multi-language type-aware resolution MCP over a warm LSP session (tsgo for TS/JS, ty for Python) — sibling to code-map. Isolated here so code-map's core stays zero-heavy-dep.
_dependencyNote: The tsgo LSP still ships via @typescript/native-preview, not GA typescript (tsc only). Pin EXACT to a known-good day; the resolver accepts current bin/tsgo and legacy bin/tsgo.js. Python uses ty via `uvx ty server` + python3 (no npm pin).
